task: According to the Otterly guide, how long should I steep green tea?

pages.title: Otterly: a guide to green tea
pages.snippet: Steep green tea for two to three minutes at 75-80 °C.
pages.html:
Otterly: a guide to green tea

Green tea turns bitter if it is steeped too long or too hot. Use water at 75–80 °C and steep for two to three minutes.
